name: Paul Gosar
page_title: Paul Gosar's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (AZ) - District 9

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Over 63 million Americans have been murdered through abortion since Roe. It's long past time to end this barbaric practice. Less than 1% of women obtain an abortion because they became pregnant through rape, and less than 0.5% do so because of incest. End abortion now."
"Pray that Roe v Wade, an egregiously immoral and unconstitutional decision, is overturned. Pray for the unborn."

"As a Catholic, I take God’s creation of life seriously. Since 1973 and the disaster of the Roe v. Wade decision, when the Supreme Court created a fake "right to privacy," 62 million babies have been murdered."
Rated 100% by the National Right to Life Committee

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Don't let the left lie to you: I oppose cuts to Social Security. I've previously introduced legislation to remove all taxes on Social Security and plan to reintroduce this year."
"I was not sent to DC to increase taxes and have consistently voted against any legislation that includes a tax increase."
Voted against S 610 "Protecting Medicare and American Farmers from Sequester Cuts Act"
Rated 0% by National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare
Rated 10% by Alliance for Retired Americans

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

"The large wind turbines, in addition to being unreliable and visual pollution, often fail catastrophically. There are 3,800 incidents of blade failure each year and 1,200 gear box failures. I am always "all of the above" energy but wind energy can only supplement our grid."

Rated 92% by the NRA

"The Second Amendment is one of the most important rights guaranteed by the Bill of Rights. The operative text states that "the right of the people to keep and bear arms…shall not be infringed." In spite of the clarity of this amendment, we have seen repeated, consistent, and sustained attacks on this right and efforts across the spectrum to "infringe" on this individual right."
